state expenses=[{name: "Groceries", cat: "Food", amt: 82}, {name: "Gas", cat: "Transport", amt: 45}, {name: "Dinner out", cat: "Food", amt: 64}, {name: "Movie", cat: "Fun", amt: 18}, {name: "Bus pass", cat: "Transport", amt: 30}] name="" cat="Food" amt=""
derive total={sum(expenses, 'amt')}
derive byCat={[{cat: "Food", amt: sum(filter(expenses, 'cat', 'Food'), 'amt')}, {cat: "Transport", amt: sum(filter(expenses, 'cat', 'Transport'), 'amt')}, {cat: "Fun", amt: sum(filter(expenses, 'cat', 'Fun'), 'amt')}]}
card
  text "Personal Spending Tracker" style=title
  stat label="Total spent" value={money(total)}
  chart "Spending by category" kind=donut items=byCat x=cat y=amt format=money
  divider
  text "Add an expense" style=lead
  column gap=10
    input "Name" bind=name placeholder="e.g. Coffee"
    select "Category" items={["Food", "Transport", "Fun"]} bind=cat placeholder="Choose a category"
    input "Amount" bind=amt kind=number placeholder="e.g. 12"
    button "Add expense" on="add:expenses:{name: name, cat: cat, amt: number(amt)};set:name:'';set:amt:''" disabled={trim(name) == '' || amt == '' || number(amt) <= 0}
  divider
  text "Expenses" style=lead
  list
    each items=expenses as=e
      list-item "{e.name}" detail="{e.cat}" trailing={money(e.amt)}
